data.cultural_impact: The name Somyadev carries rich cultural significance in the Hindu faith. It is a spiritual name that acknowledges the divine presence of the moon god, Soma, and the supreme power of the deity. In ancient Hindu society, Soma was regarded as a god of the moon, and people believed that the moon god bestowed his blessings upon them during the full moon night. The name Somyadev is also believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and mental peace.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Somyadev holds profound spiritual significance in Hinduism. It represents the connection between the individual and the deity. By invoking the name Somyadev, one seeks to bring the divine energy of the moon god into their life. It is also believed that chanting the name encourages deeper devotion and induces a sense of calm and tranquility. This name serves as a reminder of the spiritual power of the universe and the importance of staying connected to it.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Somyadev was a ruler of the Kamarupa kingdom in the 12th century. The name Somyadev carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Somyadev ruled the Kamarupa kingdom during the medieval period.
